name: status_quo
label: Alert on every failed run
about: Each check alerts its team's primary after two failed runs in a row at any location, and again after every recovery. Nobody else is paged. A responder writes the status post by hand after acknowledging.

name: double_check
label: Retry from a second location
about: A failure must be confirmed from a second location before the check alerts. Otherwise as the status quo.

name: model_only
label: A model reads the runs and acts alone
about: The stand-in model reads each check's recent runs, decides when to page the primary, and publishes its own status posts unchecked.

name: desk
label: The desk
about: Two locations confirm, one location long enough is regional, a suspect monitoring location is left out, one incident per cause with dependencies as roots, a three-level escalation policy, and model drafts that code checks before they go on the status page.

name: desk_no_blip_filter
label: The desk without the location filter

name: desk_no_noise_floor
label: The desk without the flaky-check noise floor

name: desk_no_checker
label: The desk without the claim checker
